title: runtime: fold HttpDispatcher.errorFromThrown onto the @objectstack/types thrown-answer reader so the two compositions of one answer cannot drift
body:
domain:server#6 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5p3T5YWhLjurajudnQ

## What is wrong

Since #31271 (PR #31315) there are two compositions of the same thrown-error answer:

1. `thrownAnswer` in `@objectstack/types` (the thrown arm behind `actionsDoorAnswerOf`), which `/actions` and the MCP action tools now use.
2. `HttpDispatcher.errorFromThrown` plus `this.error` (`packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts`, `private errorFromThrown`), which every other dispatcher domain uses through `deps.errorFromThrown`.

Today they agree term by term: the resolver's closed code, the engine-duplicate wire code and arm context, the demoted `declaredCode`, `userMessage` in `extra`, and the 5xx `looksLikeInternalErrorLeak` withhold. The contract review checked this. But nothing ties them together, so a change to one silently leaves the other behind. That is the drift class #31270, #31271 and #31272 exist to close.

## Expected

`HttpDispatcher.errorFromThrown` builds its answer from the types reader's thrown arm, so one composition serves every door. No wire change: the existing dispatcher pins (`http-dispatcher.error-leak.test.ts`, `dispatcher-5xx-demoted-code-withhold.test.ts`, `package-door-error-parity.test.ts`, `error-envelope.conformance.test.ts`) stay green unchanged.

## Provenance

Out-of-scope finding 2 in the contract review on PR #31315 (#31271), which escalated it to the seat for a carrier.
